The best free invoicing software, compared

Free invoicing tools differ in what "free" means: a cap on invoices or clients, branding on your invoices, or paid extras for reminders and recurring bills. Here is what each one gives without paying, from their own pages.

We make Slop Invoices, one of the tools on this page. Every fact about the other tools comes from their own pages, linked under each one, as they read on 2026-10-24. Prices and features change: check each site before you choose.

  • The invoicing basics: templates, PDF, tax, recurring invoices, quotes
  • Getting paid: online payments and reminders

1. Slop Invoices (ours)

Best for: Freelancers and small firms who want unlimited invoices with no account, and books kept on their own device

An invoicing app in the browser: gapless numbers on issue, five PDF templates, tax by rate, payments, credit notes, recurring drafts and customer statements, posted to a double-entry ledger.

Good

  • No limit on invoices, customers or templates, and no branding added to the PDF
  • Gapless numbering, credit notes and customer statements, posted to double-entry books
  • Quotes, orders, expenses, timesheets and reports are sibling apps that share the same data
  • Works offline after the first visit; nothing is uploaded

Not so good

  • Does not email invoices: you send the PDF yourself
  • No card or bank payments, no client portal, no bank feed
  • One person in one browser: no team, no sync between devices (move data with a backup file)
  • No mobile app; it runs in the phone's browser

Open Slop Invoices

2. Zoho Invoice

Best for: A complete free invoicing service with payments, a client portal and mobile apps, if 500 invoices a year is enough

Good

  • Email invoices, automatic payment reminders and recurring invoices on the free plan
  • Quotes, expenses, time tracking and a self-service customer portal
  • Apps for iOS, Android, Windows and Mac

Not so good

  • Invoices carry "Powered by Zoho Invoice" branding
  • Up to 500 invoices a year and two users
  • Data of an account inactive for over 180 days is deleted, as its FAQ says

Zoho Invoice website · Sources: Zoho Invoice pricing and FAQ

3. Wave

Best for: Unlimited free invoices with card and bank payments, plus free bookkeeping

Good

  • Unlimited estimates, invoices, bills and bookkeeping records on the free Starter plan
  • Card and bank payments through the invoice
  • Invoice on the go with its mobile app

Not so good

  • Recurring invoices, automatic reminders and removing Wave branding are on Pro
  • Bank import and receipt capture are paid (Pro or an add-on)
  • Online payments need approval, including identity checks and a credit review

Wave website · Sources: Wave pricing, Wave invoicing

4. Invoice Ninja

Best for: Feature-rich invoicing with a client portal, if you have up to five clients or will pay for Pro

Good

  • Recurring invoices, auto-billing, a client portal and deposits on the free plan
  • Quotes that clients approve online, multiple currencies, expenses and time tracking
  • Apps for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android; code on GitHub

Not so good

  • Free plan is limited to 5 clients
  • Removing "Created by Invoice Ninja", automatic reminders and reports are on Pro
  • Bank sync and extra users are Enterprise only

Invoice Ninja website · Sources: Invoice Ninja pricing, Invoice Ninja features

Which one to choose

If you want to get paid online, Wave and Zoho Invoice are the strongest free choices: both take card payments through the invoice and have mobile apps. Wave has no invoice cap; Zoho Invoice adds free recurring invoices, reminders and a client portal up to 500 invoices a year.

Invoice Ninja has the most features on paper and runs on every platform, but its free plan stops at five clients. Slop Invoices fits when you want no limits, no account and no branding, and are happy to send the PDF and record payments yourself.

Questions

Which free invoicing software has no limits?

Of these, Wave Starter allows unlimited invoices and estimates, and Slop Invoices sets no limits at all. Zoho Invoice allows 500 invoices a year and Invoice Ninja five clients on their free plans.

Which free invoice tools take card payments?

Zoho Invoice, Wave and Invoice Ninja connect to payment providers so a customer can pay from the invoice; Wave lists its card fees on its pricing page. Slop Invoices does not take payments; you record them when they arrive.

Can I make invoices without creating an account?

Slop Invoices needs no account: it runs in your browser and keeps the invoices on your device. Zoho Invoice, Wave and Invoice Ninja are online services you sign up for.

Is free invoicing software safe for my data?

The online services keep your invoices on their servers and describe their security on their own pages. Slop Invoices uploads nothing, so download a backup now and then: clearing the browser's site data deletes it.
